pcaf_methodology.listed_equity: market_value_meur / issuer_evic_meur * issuer_revenue_meur (PCAF B61 proxy — revenue used as emissions proxy due to absence of direct counterparty emissions)
pcaf_methodology.sovereign_bonds_note: issuer_evic_meur and issuer_revenue_meur are NaN for sovereign bonds by design — EVIC and revenue are corporate concepts not applicable to sovereigns
pcaf_methodology.investments_counterparty_note: counterparty_id is NaN across all investment rows — this is a known data generation gap, not a data quality error

vehicles_correction.method: Scope 1 fleet recalculated from annual_fuel_consumption_l * 2.67 kg_CO2/litre / 1000

vehicles_correction.emission_factor_source: Empirically derived from dataset — consistent 2.67 kg CO2/litre across all fuel types
